title: Samson and the Lion
reflectionQuestion: God filled Samson with courage the moment the lion leaped out. I wonder what feels a little scary to you, that God could help you face?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (new 'Judges' category -- room for future Gideon/Deborah). Batch D 'courage / action' piece. SOFTENED per Adam: just the lion encounter (Judges 14:5-6), NOT Delilah, NOT the wider tragedy. Soft on violence -- the lion 'could not hurt him', Samson 'was kept completely safe'; no killing/tearing dwelt on (the gore is omitted). CRUCIAL framing: strength is GOD'S GIFT, not Samson's muscles ('It had not come from his big strong arms. It had come from God.') -- avoids a self-reliance/strongman message. Room = God gives courage in scary moments / you are not alone / you don't have to be brave all by yourself. Ends safe. Soft close ('difference'/'brave'). VOICE_DAVID_SHEPHERD (bright, strong, good-voice; courage register).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands, but he didn’t tell his father or his mother what he had done.
